correctness.rationale: The integral product table satisfies the Zinbiel identity because A²A=0 and symmetrized products are annihilator-valued. Independent exact reconstruction gave determinants −4 and −15 for the displayed 21- and 19-row minors. Away from characteristic two the four central maps attain the nullity bound; in characteristic two C,U,V attain the six-dimensional bound. For the local upper bound in characteristic two, the basis tests leave ten coefficients. Write L(e3)=a e3+b e4, L(e5)=c e4+d e5, and let t be the e2 coefficient of L(e2). Testing e3+e5 imposes a=d and b=c, and testing e2+e3 imposes t=a; these constraints are independent over every field of characteristic two. The pointwise cancellation in the exhibited P witness works also over F2, using zero when the e1-coordinate vanishes and division only when it does not; e1e2 detects nonderivation. Thus the seven independent local maps exhaust the space, and finite-field counts follow by linearity. Independent finite replay gave (6,7) over F2 and F4 and (4,4) over F3 and F5; those samples are not the all-field argument. Frozen code was inspected, not run.
